entities.summary: Daniel Obajtek is a Polish politician and executive manager who has been serving as a member of the European Parliament since 2024. From 2006 to 2015, he was the mayor (wójt) of Gmina Pcim. Obajtek has been involved in Polish local and national politics since the early 2000s, having held various positions in local government and state agencies.
